prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 中英混排 · 会议待办 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 5 rows. Row headers: none declared.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "#" · longest unbreakable word 10px · one-line width 10px
  col 2: header "Action item" · longest unbreakable word 78px · one-line width 481px
  col 3: header "负责人" · longest unbreakable word 30px · one-line width 46px
  col 4: header "Due" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "状态" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"跟踪会议待办事项，明确每项任务、负责人、截止时间和状态。","reading":"读者主要按行查看任务及其落实情况，再纵向扫描负责人、截止时间和状态以比较各项进度。","groups":["负责人、Due 和状态共同描述任务的执行情况，适合保持紧凑并便于纵向扫描。","# 与 Action item 共同标识任务；Action item 承载主要文字，需要最多空间。"],"keep_intact":["序号","负责人姓名或标识","截止日期","状态值","英文单词及缩写，如 GDPR、Jenkins 和 GitHub Actions"],"may_wrap":["Action item 中的中英文描述可在自然断点换行；较长任务形成的行高可容纳同一行其他单元格的换行。","必要时负责人或状态中的多词内容可在词间换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [37, 153, 51, 51, 65] · table 358×461px · row heights [83, 83, 129, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 5 lines · mid-word splits 3
Design r2B: widths [37, 140, 64, 51, 65] · table 358×461px · row heights [60, 83, 153, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 6 lines · mid-word splits 3
Design r2C: widths [37, 158, 51, 51, 60] · table 358×438px · row heights [83, 83, 106, 106, 60] · column headers wrapped 1/5 · tallest cell 4 lines · mid-word splits 3
Constraint adjustments applied: r2A: raised a column to the minimum 38px; scaled down from 366px to fit 359px
r2B: raised a column to the minimum 38px; scaled down from 366px to fit 359px
r2C: raised a column to the minimum 38px; scaled down from 366px to fit 359px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"序号与任务的关系清楚，任务列获得了主要空间；各行有足够的高度容纳中英文描述。","problems":"负责人表头逐字竖排，王强被拆成两行；多数日期被拆开，状态也频繁换行，削弱了执行信息的纵向扫描。","cause":"负责人列 51px 只有 30px 内容宽度，放不下三字表头或姓名的完整宽度；Due 列 51px 比最长日期所需的 52px 少 1px。状态列 65px 也略低于完整显示最长状态所需的 67px。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"负责人列较宽，王强保持完整，负责人信息比其他两版更容易辨认。","problems":"负责人表头仍换行；任务描述更窄，第二项达到六行，整行显得过高。日期仍被拆开，状态也频繁换行。","cause":"负责人列 64px 比三字表头所需的约 66px 略窄；任务列缩至 140px，增加了英文描述的换行。Due 列 51px 仍不足以容纳最长日期。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"任务列最宽，第二项压缩到四行，整表高度较低；任务文字的节奏比 r2B 舒展。","problems":"负责人表头逐字竖排，王强被拆开；多数日期被拆开，状态值也换行。执行信息与任务主体之间的阅读节奏因此不够稳定。","cause":"负责人列 51px 不足以容纳完整表头和最长姓名；Due 列 51px 比最长日期所需的 52px 少 1px；状态列 60px 放不下最长状态。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"balanced-owner","widths":[38,150,66,54,51],"change":"把负责人列增至 66px，使表头和姓名保持完整；Due 增至 54px 保持日期完整。状态列收紧，让状态在字间换行，把剩余空间留给任务描述。"},{"name":"task-first","widths":[38,157,51,57,56],"change":"保留接近 r2C 的宽任务列，并把 Due 加宽至 57px，优先修复日期拆分；负责人和状态仍可能换行，用于比较任务可读性与执行信息完整性的取舍。"},{"name":"execution-balance","widths":[38,143,66,52,60],"change":"完整保留负责人表头、姓名和日期，同时给状态列更多空间；以较窄的任务列换取执行信息更稳定的纵向扫描。"}]}
